Rank2 p=odd k=1 has explicit rank2 Gram; k>=2 null-cone Gram gives rank3, and rank2 exclusion by >2 distinct isotropic lines. originality.rationale: FAIL: Reddy–Samant 2023 already explicitly identifies the group graph as a complete multipartite component plus isolates. Fallat–Hogben 2007 survey, Example 2.19, gives the real symmetric minimum rank exactly 2 when third-largest part <=2 and 3 when third-largest >=3, reproducing the full k=1 versus k>=2 transition by substitution. Boyer et al 2018 Theorem 1 gives the three highest zero-forcing polynomial coefficients for every graph, while Resultary October 4 full general complete-multipartite characterization supplies the exact two-white forcing criterion and its count. Combined with compulsory isolates, all submitted coefficients and minimum sets follow immediately. These are stronger prior implications, not only matching terminology.
residual_risks: All calculations mathematically correct, but scientifically covered by earlier stronger general formulas.
The published full generating graph structure assumes the full graph on all group elements and isolates; alternative reduced definitions would change formula but not restore originality here.
